ownership: DirectoryHandle.close owns the directory kernel handle. The workflow owns file handles returned by write_exclusive and closes them in _close.
duplication: The helper does not duplicate handles.
double_close: A second DirectoryHandle.close is a no-op. Tested.
use_after_close: create and write fail with handle_closed. Tested.
invalid_handle: A closed handle is rejected before NtCreateFile. An arbitrary foreign handle value was not probed.
interrupted_write: A short WriteFile still fails with interrupted_write. G.14.7 regression passed. The partial file is not deleted.
deletion_while_open: os.rmdir succeeded while the child handle was open. The next create failed with handle_create_failed.
cleanup: Handles are closed on success and failure. Directories are not deleted by the helper.
threads: No lock is taken around the handle. Concurrent calls on one DirectoryHandle were not tested.
repeated_acquisition: G.14.7 still rejects a second run into a used destination.
leaks_observed: None in the tests that close handles. A process crash before _close is untested.
